html:
Kigali, the capital of Rwanda, began as a German administrative post founded in 1907 by Richard Kandt, in the centre of the country.

Under Belgian rule the colonial capital of Ruanda-Urundi was Usumbura, now Bujumbura, and Kigali stayed small. It became the capital at independence in 1962 because of its central position.

It was the heart of the genocide in 1994, when thousands were killed in its churches and streets. The Kigali Genocide Memorial holds the remains of about 250,000 people. Since then it has grown fast, known for clean streets, monthly community work days, a ban on plastic bags and conference halls that are part of Kagame's vision of Rwanda as a service hub.
sum: Kigali, the capital of Rwanda, began as a German administrative post founded in 1907 by Richard Kandt, in the centre of the country.
